source_text: Vox turturis: sapientia quam dispensator Verbi loquitur inter perfectos, abscondita in mysterio. Turtur in secretioribus locis vitam agit, a multitudine aliena — deserta montium aut secreta silvarum.
pass_a_gloss: Voice of-turtledove: wisdom which steward of-Word speaks among perfect-ones, hidden in mystery. Turtledove in more-secret places life leads, from multitude alien — deserts of-mountains or secrets of-woods.
pass_b_english: The turtledove’s voice is the wisdom the Word’s steward [[speaks among the perfect, God’s wisdom hidden in a mystery >> Bible:1 Corinthians 2:6-7]]. The turtledove lives in more secret places, apart from the crowd — mountain wastes or woodland secrets.
